## History

While her father was away and her aunt was bedridden with an illness, Minnie and her siblings attempted to manage the household and care for her sick brother. While trying to clean the house by shaking rugs in the adjacent graveyard on a Monday, they inadvertently caused a scandal in the community when neighbors mistook their actions for occurring on Sunday. After struggling with cooking and running low on food, their troubles ended when her aunt recovered and her family returned to join them in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

Minnie was rescued by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a past encounter. Since that initial event, [Anne](../character/anne.md) remains the individual who saved her life.

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--minnie.md)

Minnie and [Faith](../character/faith.md) are best friends who attend school together. Their close bond as classmates forms the core of their ongoing friendship during their time in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).
